purpose: Qualification of native CM29 measured gamut reuse over finite target black [0, 0.005] nits; not universal arbitrary-color mapper acceptance.

method.direct: Same integer target-peak-normalized IPT vertices, inverse source construction per black; neutral and lift -0.5 families; flat 11x5 tiles.
method.holdout: 300000 fixed-seeded attempted target-peak-normalized IPT positions, lift -0.5, up to 100000 physically reachable BT.2020/PQ inputs per case; compare common sample IDs only; flat 11x5 tiles.
method.native_comparison: Licensed native P3/PQ float32 output multiplied by 65535, paired to the 0.005-nit reference at identical normalized coordinates. Includes source float32 construction and licensed-renderer numerical variation; does not assert bit-identical internal tables.
method.stress_scope: Unpartitioned whole RGB grid deliberately includes values outside the declared source P3 / 4000-nit mastering volume. All large residuals and every worsening retained.
